Description: Host city of the Olympic Games edition
Four-digit year representing the Olympic Games edition (1896 to 2008)
Role_in_Analysis: Temporal trend analysis, Era grouping, feature in models

Description: High-level Olympic sport category governed by an international federation
Role_in_Analysis: Primary grouping, association mining, classifier feature

Description: Specific branch of a sport comprising one or more events
Example_Values: Swimming, Diving, Athletics, Fencing, Cycling Track

Description: Full name of the medalist in "SURNAME, Given name" format
Example_Values: PHELPS, Michael; LATYNINA, Larisa; LEWIS, Carl
Role_in_Analysis: Individual rankings, Group split key (preventing data leakage)

Description: Three-letter IOC National Olympic Committee country code
Example_Values: USA, URS, GBR, GER, FRA, ITA, CHN, IND
Role_in_Analysis: Geographic analysis, national specialization, ARM item

Description: Biological sex / gender of the participating athlete (Men / Women)
Role_in_Analysis: Gender parity trends, feature for classification & ARM

Description: Specific competitive event contested within a sport/discipline
Role_in_Analysis: Event-level aggregation, team vs individual classification

Description: Gender category designation of the event (M: Men, W: Women, X: Mixed)
Role_in_Analysis: Gender consistency audit, mixed event analysis

Description: Medal tier awarded to the competitor (Gold, Silver, Bronze)
Role_in_Analysis: Target variable for predictive classification, ARM item

Description: Historical epoch binned into 5 recognized geopolitical eras
Example_Values: Pre-WWI, Interwar, Post-WWII, Late Cold War, Modern Era
